target: BridgeDrive Table 2 Full Diffusion geo; paper-based reproduction
assumptions: Reuse the public NAVSIM TrajectoryFullDiffuHead structure and BridgeDrive attention/position components, adapting its output to Garage 10-point geometry plus one continuous speed scalar.
Frozen official all_towns model_0030_1.pth; Garage fusion tokens replace NAVSIM agent queries; a trainable target-point token preserves navigation conditioning.
Global batch 64 on four A100 GPUs, weight decay 1e-4, gradient clipping 1.0, bf16; these are reproduction choices, not reported paper settings.
Full Gaussian VP uses beta_d=19.9 and beta_min=0.1 so terminal alpha squared is below 5e-5. The paper's beta_d=2 describes its anchor bridge, not a pure-Gaussian terminal distribution.
No noisy-latent clamping or output clipping inside DDIM; 100 deterministic reverse steps; x0 prediction and metric L1 supervised at both decoder layers.
Whole-route deterministic 5% validation, seed 901; critical-frame rules compare adjacent raw frames, retaining 14% of unchanged frames.
Train-only per-point normalization with standard-deviation floor 0.1; metric path/speed L1 excludes the speed token's dummy second coordinate.
Use the checkpoint's repetition limit and 10-frame initial skip; reuse Garage camera/LiDAR augmentation and its 2.5m initial path offset followed by 1m geometric spacing.
